labs.name: Nair Lab
labs.description: Studies the genetic mechanisms behind cancer development and uses molecular biology, genome editing, and genomics to investigate new cancer treatments.

labs.name: CARES Lab
labs.description: Explores how people share, understand, and influence each other's emotions, and how social and emotional relationships can affect mental and physical health as we age.

labs.name: Weiner Lab
labs.topics: Cancer immunology / Cell therapy / Pancreatic cancer
labs.description: Investigates immune resistance in pancreatic cancer and explores engineered natural killer (NK) cells as potential therapies.

labs.name: Ekong Research Group
labs.topics: Pediatric immunology / Liver disease / Basic science
labs.description: Studies the immune processes behind autoimmune hepatitis and post-transplant liver inflammation in children to identify biomarkers and potential therapeutic targets.

labs.name: Braselmann Lab
labs.description: Develops ways to observe RNA and proteins in living cells over time, helping researchers understand how biological molecules react to healthy and disease-related changes.

labs.name: Tercyak Lab
labs.topics: Cancer prevention / Behavioral science / Public health
labs.description: Studies how individuals and families understand and respond to cancer risk, and how communication, counseling, and behavioral interventions can improve prevention.

labs.name: Lombardi Cancer Research Training
labs.description: Connects students with cancer research training and education through Georgetown Lombardi's work in scientific discovery, clinical research, and community partnership.

labs.name: PAIRADIME Lab
labs.description: Uses culturally informed, interdisciplinary research to understand Black adults' mental and physical wellness, including lived experiences and health practices, with the goal of reducing health disparities.
labs.contact: Application link will be supplied at the fair

labs.name: Purushottam Tiwari
labs.topics: Computational biophysics / Biomolecular interactions / Drug development
labs.description: Uses computational methods to investigate how biomolecules interact, with potential applications to drug development.

labs.name: Glasgow Lab
labs.description: Studies cancer, toxicology, and brain development using zebrafish, a vertebrate model for understanding biological processes.
